annotations.title: Prepare a dispute of an x402 conditional payment (unsigned)

description: For the buyer, inside the release window: returns the EIP-712 Decision (action 5, dispute) to sign with the buyer's wallet, and the relay call (POST /v1/v2/vaults/{vault}/dispute with the signature) that sends it with IFSO paying the gas. After a dispute only the referee decides (or the buyer's own OK, or the seller's decline); a silent referee means the money comes back at expiry. This tool never signs.

deadline.description: Signature deadline, unix seconds (default: one hour, at most the window end).
